import json, time, subprocess, sys, resource
files = ["hard_case.json", "hard_case2.json", "hard_case3.json", "hard_case4.json", "hard_case5.json", "case_19968.json"]
objs = []
for f in files:
    o = json.load(open(f))
    o["queries"] = [["t%02d" % i for i in range(len(o["services"]))] for _ in range(3)]
    objs.append(o)
# 8 lines: 5 hard + 3 repeats of the slowest
payload = b"".join((json.dumps(o) + "\n").encode() for o in objs + objs[:3])
print("payload bytes", len(payload), "lines", 8)
t0 = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "/workspace/submission/main.py"], input=payload, capture_output=True)
el = time.time() - t0
lines = p.stdout.decode().splitlines()
print("8 hard distinct lines: %.2fs rc=%d outlines=%d outbytes=%d childrss=%dMiB" % (
    el, p.returncode, len(lines), len(p.stdout), resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss//1024))
# verify each output is structurally valid (quick check: parse and check sizes)
import validate_out, random
rng = random.Random(3)
allobjs = objs + objs[:3]
for o, l in zip(allobjs, lines):
    out = json.loads(l)
    assert out["ok"]
    assert len(out["dfa"]["accept"]) == len(out["dfa"]["next"]) == len(out["dfa"]["distance"])
    print("  states", len(out["dfa"]["accept"]), "accepting", sum(out["dfa"]["accept"]))
EOF
